newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial postpones offering to Q1.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial postpones offering to Q1.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said on Tuesday that it postponed a previously announced two million share public offering until the first quarter of 1997, citing recent weakness in the gaming sector and overall market conditions.
The underwriting group for the offering is led by John G. Kinnard and Co Inc and Pennsylvania Merchant Group Ltd.

Game Financial provides gaming establishments, mainly casinos, with comprehensive services that allow their patrons to access cash through the use of credit card cash advance services, check cashing services and automated teller machines.
